title: American Drive Acquisition Company combines with EasyPost
latest: Definitive business combination agreement announced Nov. 18, 2026; closing date not stated.
sum: EasyPost and SPAC American Drive Acquisition Company signed a definitive business combination agreement that would make EasyPost a public company. The deal values EasyPost at a pre-money equity value of $479 million.
who: A special purpose acquisition company listed on Nasdaq (ADAC), led by technology and logistics investors.
A multi-carrier shipping AI and API platform connecting shippers to carriers for labels, tracking, insurance and analytics.
why: The companies put the pro forma enterprise value at $576 million, about 4.1x estimated 2026 revenue of $141 million. They expect about $211 million of net cash proceeds, assuming no redemptions, and say the money would fund organic growth and M&A in a parcel market they estimate at $50 billion.

title: UPS buys Smartways Logistics
latest: UPS announced the agreement on Nov. 17, 2026; closing is expected in the first half of 2027.
sum: UPS agreed to acquire Smartways Logistics, a healthcare logistics provider serving Australia and New Zealand. The value and terms were not disclosed.
who: Global package delivery and logistics company that runs UPS Healthcare.
Healthcare logistics provider serving Australia and New Zealand, with services for life sciences, medical devices, clinical trials and radiopharmaceuticals.
why: UPS said the planned acquisition is part of a broader strategy of investing in healthcare capabilities in Asia Pacific, including the recently opened Clark hub in the Philippines and healthcare cold-chain investments. UPS said healthcare revenue reached $3 billion for the third consecutive quarter in Q3. The transaction is subject to customary regulatory reviews and approvals.
note: Expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.

buyer: Undisclosed (Uber and DoorDash held early talks)

title: Stord acquires AMS Fulfillment
sum: Stord has acquired AMS Fulfillment, a third-party logistics provider, in its largest acquisition to date. The sources do not state a price.
who: Fulfillment network and commerce technology provider founded in 2015 that serves independent commerce brands.
Third-party logistics provider for premium beauty, wellness and high-velocity direct-to-consumer brands, with more than 20 years of experience.
why: The deal adds more than 10 million annual orders and facilities in the Los Angeles, Salt Lake City and Philadelphia areas, and takes Stord's network to more than 100 locations. It is Stord's twelfth acquisition, following Shipwire from CMA CGM, Ware2Go from UPS and Pitney Bowes' e-commerce fulfillment business. Stord said some AMS facilities already use automated put walls and sortation systems.

updates.t: UniUni agrees to go public through MAK Acquisition at about $1 billion
MAK sends UniUni a notice of material breach, starting a 15-business-day cure period
MAK terminates the purchase agreement; the go-public deal will not proceed

srcs.src: MAK Acquisition (GlobeNewswire, via The Manila Times)

latest: MAK terminated the purchase agreement on Oct. 20, 2026; the go-public deal will not proceed.
sum: UniUni agreed on May 15, 2026 to go public through a reverse takeover by MAK Acquisition Corp. at about US$1.0 billion. MAK sent a notice of material breach on Sept. 24, 2026 and terminated the purchase agreement on Oct. 20, 2026, so the deal will not proceed.
note: MAK said UniUni breached an interim covenant capping its cumulative pre-tax loss and did not cure it before the cure period expired Oct. 19. MAK is withdrawing its preliminary prospectus and will keep looking for a qualifying acquisition.
